description: Contractual attendance allowance paid when the terms set a positive amount; treated as remuneration and included in the overtime base.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.3(5), 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii) (報酬), 雇用保険法 art.4(4) (賃金), 所得税法 art.28 (給与所得) and in the overtime base (労働基準法 art.37(5) does not exclude it); excluded from the wage compared with the minimum wage (最低賃金法 art.4(3)(iii) with 施行規則 art.1(2)(i)). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

description: Non-taxable portion of the contractual commuting allowance, paid up to the statutory monthly limit for transit or car commuting, including parking.

references.title: 所得税法
references.locator: 9条1項5号、所得税法施行令20条の2（通勤手当）
references.quote: 通勤手当は、合理的な運賃額の範囲で非課税とする。

description: Taxable excess of the contractual commuting allowance above the statutory non-taxable monthly limit.

references.title: 所得税法
references.locator: 9条1項5号、所得税法施行令20条の2（通勤手当）
references.quote: 1か月当たりの非課税となる限度額を超えて通勤手当を支給する場合には、超える部分の金額が給与として課税されます。

description: Contractual family allowance paid when the terms set a positive amount; treated as remuneration.

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: 家族手当は、労働の対償として支払われる限り報酬に含まれる。

description: Contractual fixed allowance paid when the terms set a positive amount; treated as remuneration, salary income and part of the overtime base.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.3(5) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii) (報酬), 雇用保険法 art.4(4) (賃金) and 所得税法 art.28 (給与所得): a fixed allowance is remuneration, salary income and in the overtime base. A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

description: Contractual housing allowance paid when the terms set a positive amount; treated as remuneration, and excluded from the overtime base when it varies with housing cost.

references.title: Remuneration, wages and salary income; excluded from the overtime base only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法施行規則 art.21(iii), 平成11年3月31日 基発170号). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.
